execution: fractional adjusted-return exposure; full round trip every cycle; no claim of actual fills
timing: feature after decision close; entry next observed session close; returns start following entry; fold warmup 26 sessions; no cycle crosses fold end
selection: current provider universe; eligible on decision date only; top five by rule, symbol tie break; unoccupied slots stay cash
calibration: constant positive-net-cycle frequency fitted on validation only; never refit on test/holdout
missing_held_return: abort study and retain consumed receipt; never drop a losing/missing observation
promotion: requires source rights, historical point-in-time/universe, cost/execution and independent release evidence in addition to statistical checks; never automatic
